title: TTS Provider Adapter Contract
description: Two related shapes every TTS provider adapter must normalize to/from, so provider-specific request/response shapes never leak past the composite `Generate Voiceover Chunk` workflow — see docs/architecture/voiceover-pipeline.md#tts-provider-architecture. `$defs/request` is what n8n builds before calling the provider; `$defs/response` is what n8n builds from the provider's HTTP response (headers + status) after the audio bytes themselves are handed off to the renderer — audio is never represented as JSON here.

text.description: Pronunciation-adjusted TTS input text — see docs/architecture/voiceover-pipeline.md#pronunciation-handling. Never the raw narration if a pronunciation transform applied.

settings.description: Provider-specific tuning (stability, similarity, style, speaking_rate, output_format, sample_rate, ...) — passed through opaquely, never interpreted by the shared workflow logic.

usage_quantity.description: Provider billing unit quantity (e.g. characters sent).

duration_seconds.description: Provider-reported duration, if any — the renderer's own ffprobe measurement is authoritative, this is informational only.

metadata.description: Non-secret provider response metadata only — never a credential or raw auth header.
